title: Find your rhythm
text: A clock run is open tonight. No pressure to start here: the map has several meets. Set GPS if you want to learn the city one clean run at a time.

title: The block is awake
text: We run a circuit through these streets. Bring your own build and see who you can stay with. Come when you're ready; the meet isn't going anywhere.

title: Take the long way
text: Heard you put a result on the board. There's a sprint with room to breathe. Bring whatever you own. Or spend your winnings first and meet us later.

title: A different kind of line
text: The drift crowd is at First Slide. If that's your thing, bring a rear-drive build. If it isn't, the circuit and sprint crews still have plenty for you.

title: Dockside signal
text: Kite vouched for you. Pipeline is running through the industrial district tonight. Several other dock meets are open too. Pick your line.

title: A crew to chase
text: The dock crew likes close racing. Bring your own car to their circuit. Club parts are available at the workshop if your build needs some attention.

title: Straight talk
text: Redline Receipt is open. A drag build can earn its keep here, but this is an invitation, not a requirement. You've got options.

title: Cross-town frequency
text: The freeway crowd knows your name now. Cross Town is a good place to introduce your headlights. Your other meets are on the map.

title: Keep it tidy
text: Night Loop rewards a balanced car. You could build for grip, save for another set of keys, or head to a different meet. It's your garage.

title: Smoke in the city
text: Concrete Lines has room for a styled drift build. We're looking for smooth transitions. There's no deadline; come back when the car feels right.

title: Meet us above the noise
text: The hills are open. Ridge Run asks for a clean line and a little restraint. Find your own pace before you chase ours.

title: One more exit
text: Last Exit is moving tonight. Bring a car you trust at speed. The hill clocks and circuits are open if you prefer another route.

title: A silhouette on the ridge
text: Slip Angle has a drift meet above the city. A specialist build helps. Nobody's keeping you from the grip events while you build one.

title: Every district is listening
text: You've brought this city together. City Frequency is one of several open meets. Four different results will bring Nocturne out.

title: Use the whole dial
text: Full Band is open for a sprint. Take your favourite car, or try something different from your garage. The night is yours to arrange.

title: Leave a signal
text: Smoke Signal is waiting for the drift crowd. If you're chasing your final four wins elsewhere, we'll still be here after the rival.

title: Let's put a name to this.
text: You've earned a challenge. My meet is marked on your map. Bring a car you own, and come when you're ready. Every other meet stays open.

title: A shakedown near home
text: The commercial blocks have a two-lap clock meet. A good place to learn how your build changes direction. Pick it whenever you like; the other chapter meets still count.

title: The pier has its own rhythm
text: A new clock meet runs through the waterfront warehouses. Two laps, your own car. Try a different setup at Saltline first, or take what you already know.

title: Lights, camera, your car
text: The studio crowd has opened a figure-eight clock run. It mixes quick roads and tight lots. Build for balance, bring a specialist, or choose another meet; your call.

title: More than straight-line pace
text: Urban Current connects the climbs, the street grid and the plaza. Three laps ask for consistency. Tune the car you own and come when you are ready.

title: A longer night
text: All City is open: two full laps linking the island, bridge and mainland. It pays for the commitment. Take the long run if you want, or qualify for Nocturne through the shorter meets.
